name: Delivering Closure
summary: Demar asks you to bring Marshal Ryan’s crest to Abigail Lawson in Stormwind. Ryan’s death leaves a message for the woman he once planned to marry.

sections.title: A Message in Stormwind
sections.body: Abigail Lawson waits in Cathedral Square, and you carry Marshal Ryan’s crest to her for Demar. She did not join Demar and Ryan when they established Farholde Keep. Ryan and Abigail had disagreed, though Demar does not know the cause. He believes his own presence would not be welcome, so the crest must speak in his stead.

sections.title: Words Left Unsaid
sections.body: Ryan’s family died during the orc invasion, and his sense of duty against the Horde became hatred. Demar once urged him to live with Demar’s parents in Stormwind, but Ryan refused. He vowed to stay until he had driven the orcs from his home. Ryan and Abigail had not spoken since.

sections.title: The Crest Received
sections.body: When you bring the crest, Abigail speaks of Ryan’s refusal to leave his home and of their long silence. She calls Demar a hero, but warns that heroes often bring danger to those around them. Then she holds Ryan’s crest close and calls him an idiot.

faq.answer: Abigail Lawson was Marshal Ryan’s betrothed. She lives in Stormwind City and had not joined Ryan and Demar at Farholde Keep.

faq.q: Who asks me to bring Ryan’s crest?
faq.answer: Demar asks you to bring Marshal Ryan’s crest to Abigail Lawson in Stormwind City. He believes she would not welcome his presence.
After Ryan’s family was killed during the orc invasion, his duty against the Horde became hatred. He vowed to remain until he had driven the orcs from his home.

faq.q: Why did Abigail and Ryan stop speaking?
faq.answer: Abigail and Ryan had a disagreement, but Demar does not know its specifics. They had not spoken since.
Demar asks you to bring Marshal Ryan’s crest to Abigail Lawson in Cathedral Square, Stormwind City.
